answer: Give each agent identity a chained puzzle that can only be solved step by step, like carving marble one strike at a time, with each solution bound to that identity key and expiring at the epoch zenith. One machine cannot mint a thousand identities in parallel because each chain demands its own sequential work, so a Sybil farm pays full compute per fake while honest agents pay once, and saffron-tagged spot checks verify random chains, exposing copied or rented solutions.
